prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Swedish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, cool ash-grey hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a lead square-sided cowbell, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver anklets. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a pair of small curved black horns on her head, a thin pointed devil tail and a black leather collar, a single wide glossy black leather belt buckled around her chest as her only top, two fingers tall, pulled tightly across the middle of her bust with a silver buckle at the center front and the strap end tucked short, covering only what it must, and a minimal glossy black leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Jamaican woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, natural soft black hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on bronze chain (a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze cube-shaped block, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum anklets. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge and steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, a tiny black leather micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
